answer: Use a prediction market on honesty: each agent locks a 100-unit anchor bond, and the market publishes a crystal-clear fraud-risk price for every identity. Counterparties can bet against any trader they distrust, so suspicion itself becomes priced information. A ferrous-hard rule throttles any identity priced above 20% fraud risk to one trade per epoch. A fake that cheats loses its 100-unit bond and its price collapses, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 units up front yet can barely trade at all.
